<!-- pr-reviewer: 01e74d74cf07c43151015c3d7dd8efe3f4585a1b -->
**Ready for the maintainer to merge.**

What looks good
- Test-only: one pin value changed in `bore_path_matches` (Windows x86_64 arm) plus a new exact-pin test; no verification, level, fallback or budget assertion is touched. The Windows triple now equals the Linux and macOS arm64 pins already on main.
- `the_windows_x86_64_bore_count_pin_is_exact` accepts the new triple and rejects the old one and every off-by-one, matching the existing per-OS pin tests.
- Decision file `docs/decisions/3050-bore-windows-pin.md` records the readings and the dropped alternatives; body has `Changelog: none` and `Fixes #3050`.

Results (locally, macOS arm64, merged with upstream main 2ec4ad7e0, no conflicts)
- `cargo xtask gate quick --base upstream/main`: `pocket3d_hsm` whole suite ok.
- `cargo test --release -p camcraft-app --test pocket3d_hsm -- --ignored --exact the_users_bore_roughs_adaptive_level_by_level_and_verifies_clean`: 1 passed (macOS arm64 matches (3158, 3130, 1141)).
- `cargo clippy -p camcraft-app --all-targets -- -D warnings`: clean.

Notes (not blocking)
- The Windows pin and its new test are `cfg`-gated and could not run here; they rest on the author's bacon reading (Windows-only, not re-verified by me).

Requested before merge: none.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.
